0022600127.text: Golden State (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Pacific and 2.5 games back, 15th in the West) visits Denver (1-1, on a one-game win streak, 4th in the Northwest and 1 game back, 8th in the West) for the Warriors' fourth game of the season. Out for Golden State are Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (undisclosed) are day-to-day, and for Denver, Julian Strawther is out (knee sprain) and Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on 2026-03-29 in Denver, where the Warriors lost 116-93.
